blurb.en: Eight-output clocked modulation source, BPM-synced, every output independently editable. OLED readout, program encoder, superseded by the PRO.
blurb.fi: Kahdeksan ulostulon kellotettu modulaatiolähde, synkronoitu BPM:ään, jokainen ulostulo muokattavissa erikseen. OLED-näyttö, ohjelmaenkooderi, seuraaja on PRO-versio.
blurb.sv: Åtta-utgångars klockad modulationskälla, synkad till BPM, varje utgång redigerbar för sig. OLED-display, programenkoder, efterträdd av PRO-versionen.

pull.q: There is no doubt that within the confines of a frankly ludicrously small 8HP, Pam's New Workout offers an amazing amount of versatility.

quotes.t: It is a little fiddly: I found myself pressing and scrolling incorrectly a few times.
I think I've become a Pam Fan again.
